descriptionHtml:
Bug B05 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P0

After a failed summary retry, today's note contains yesterday-only values; a partial summary still says '✓ Note saved' and yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panel without notice

Tickets: TFA-92592 / TFA-92588 ready for pr · counts as a QA bug: no (fix in PR #100/#101) · found on: dev + local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-10/S12

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S26 Save Note outcome by which AI call fails, both modes: summary fails, summary returns without its background and studies, task extraction fails, nothing fails

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident each seeded with yesterday's Background / Admission Summary one-liner and one study (for row R2); …

When Per mode: R1 ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes failFirst → type, Save Note, open Encounter, then Save Note again with no failure; R2 parsePreRoundNotes mockResponses returns a success payload with background '' and radiology [] → Save Note; …

Then R1: 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn’t be updated … tap Save Note to retry' is visible, the textarea still holds the typed text, and on the Encounter tab Generate Note & Finish is disabled with the 'did not finish processing' reason; after the clean second Save no error and Generate enabled. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. R1 and R4 are asserted from U6/T4 in both modes (the Nursing Home catch in useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts that #89 added runs only here: S12 seeds its error and S11 is Hospital only). R2 is asserted on the literal U6 ('never silently reused'): Fail if yesterday's one-liner or study is shown with only '✓ … Auto-updated' and no notice naming them; …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When the summary comes back without background and studies, the physician sees '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated…' (Nursing Home shows just 'Saved 3:16 PM'). Yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panels, and nothing says they were not refreshed.

Evidence: allure c07b5c10: R2 fails in both modes. R1 (summary fails) and R4 pass, and R3 (task extraction fails) is recorded under Q15. TC-10 Q14 and TC-10 risks already describe this: parsePreRoundNotes uses Promise.allSettled and only the main extraction throws. It fails under either answer to Q14 (an error with Generate disabled, or a notice naming the stale panels). Daniela picks which one.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S26

Save Note outcome by which AI call fails, both modes: summary fails, summary returns without its background and studies, task extraction fails, nothing fails

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec per mode, fresh account, socket-level faults/mocks: R1 parse fails once then a clean Save; R2 parse mocked with background '' and radiology [] over yesterday's seeded one-liner/study; R3 (Hospital) extractTasks fails once then Save again; R4 nothing fails (mocked success). Assert R1/R4 from U6/T4; R2 judged on literal U6; R3 recorded (Q15). After review: Nursing Home success is never counted from the 'Saved <time>' stamp (its '✓ Auto-updated' line sits in the collapsed editor): whether a success message is visible is recorded (needs a decision); R2 also records the panels' 'Updated <time> · <date>' line and the stored lastUpdatedAt stamps. — All faults are injected at the WebSocket (no model call); Generate is only checked enabled/disabled, never pressed.

Detail:

Re-run 17:02. R1 Hospital passes ('Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated … tap Save Note to retry', text kept, Generate disabled with 'did not finish processing'; clean second Save → '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: …', Generate enabled). R1 Nursing Home: the failure half passes the same way; after the clean second Save Generate is enabled, but no success message is visible — only the 'Saved 5:02 PM · Oct 14' stamp (its '✓ Auto-updated' line sits inside the collapsed editor) — recorded, not counted as the oracle's success message. R4 Hospital passes ('✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: admission reason, vitals, labs, radiology, hospital course', Generate enabled). R4 Nursing Home: Generate enabled; no success message visible, only 'Saved 5:03 PM · Oct 14' — recorded (the same stamp R2 shows, so Nursing Home gives no success signal at all; whether 'Saved <time>' is the success message needs a decision). R2 fails both modes. R3 recorded (Q15): alert 'The note was saved, but its follow-up tasks couldn't be extracted.'; the next Save recovered both tasks, a third Save made no duplicates.

Product issue: When the summary comes back without background and studies: Hospital shows '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: vitals, labs, hospital course' and restamps the background panel 'Updated 5:02 PM · Oct 14' directly under yesterday's one-liner 'Admitted with community-acquired pneumonia, improving on IV antibiotics.' (usePreRoundProcess.ts:394 sets admissionSummary.lastUpdatedAt = now even when no background came back), with yesterday's study 'Chest X-ray: right lower lobe infiltrate' still on the panel — so yesterday's text is labelled as updated today. Nursing Home shows only the 'Saved <time>' stamp, identical to a full success (its lastUpdatedAt is restamped too), so nothing tells the physician the panels were not refreshed. Breaks TC-10 U6 literal ('yesterday's panels are never silently reused'); whether a notice naming them is enough is Q14. Also for Daniela: Nursing Home Save Note shows no success message in any outcome (R1 retry, R4) — is 'Saved <time>' the success message?

Record only (recordOnly):

  • NH R1 second Save and NH R4: no success message visible, only 'Saved <time>' (decision)
  • R3 (Q15)

Evidence: 8 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our chromium spec, not written yet): faults injected with action-observer failFirst / mockResponses on ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes and ai/parsing:extractTasks, on a fresh account seeded with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
